comment: The W3C SHACL 1.0 suite gate (shacl/qualification/harness/suite.mjs --expect). Every verdict must be right. The engine's own results are isomorphic to the expected report on all but the 12 SPARQL tests whose expected report has sh:sourceConstraint, which PurRDF does not emit (W3 found the same 12); the report Erden writes adds it where the result determines it and is isomorphic on all 120. Any other outcome fails the gate.
